note: ERROR SHAPE, HAND-AUTHORED -- this could not be recorded on the bench and is not a recording. On 2026.8.0 nothing answers on the server port until the process is up, so restarting the container yields a refused connection, never a 503; the {"error": "authentik starting"} body belongs to a deployment with a reverse proxy in front of authentik. A 5xx is reachability, not a verdict on the credential or the data: warn and retry, do not count it against the source and do not touch the population.
